description:
A Hohmann Transfer mission script is loaded in GMAT. This mission transfers the spacecraft 'DefaultSC' from a 300 km altitude Low Earth Orbit (LEO) to Geostationary Earth Orbit (GEO) using differential correction targeting.

Your task: raise the spacecraft's initial orbit from 300 km altitude to 500 km altitude. This means changing the Semi-Major Axis (SMA) from 6678.14 km to 6878.14 km (Earth radius ~6378 km + desired altitude). After making the change, run the mission to verify the updated transfer orbit completes successfully.
